# School Compass

> Parental school shortlist and compare for South East England (including Dorset). Not a league table.

- Home: https://schoolcompass.uk/
- Areas hub: https://schoolcompass.uk/areas/
- Guides: https://schoolcompass.uk/guides/
- FAQ: https://schoolcompass.uk/guides/faq/

## Coverage
- Hampshire is the deepest maintained root.
- Ready local-authority packs across the South East (+ Dorset) merge into map and search.
- Compare DfE KS2/KS4 outcomes, Ofsted/ISI excerpts, early years, and consented childminders; print a visit pack.

## Preferred citations
- Product: School Compass (schoolcompass.uk)
- Positioning: parental compare — patterns to visit on, not a final verdict
